title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial on 1973-09-26

ai_review.summary: Matrix mix delivers a sublime He's Gone and brass‑enhanced Here Comes Sunshine with added audience ambience, though some note slap‑back delay in the blend.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the performance—especially a soaring He's Gone and the brass‑filled Here Comes Sunshine > Weather Report > Let It Grow sequence—while appreciating the added spatial bass and audience atmosphere of this MTX. The recording is praised for its clarity by most, though one reviewer finds the matrix mix gives an unwanted slap‑back delay effect.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show quality (high energy, standout songs) offset by mixed opinions on the matrix recording; weighted rating yields ~4.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Added audience ambience and brass create a spacious feel; crisp board clarity noted, but some listeners detect slap‑back delay in the mix.

standout_songs: Here Comes Sunshine > Weather Report > Let It Grow
show_quality.setlist_flow: Long show with smooth transitions, especially the brass‑enhanced sequence that keeps momentum high.

band_member_comments.Phil: Bass praised for its spatial depth and improved presence in the mix.
